findings.evidence: quality-gates API has no AuthMiddleware installed. All endpoints (gate execution, release approval, evidence access) are publicly accessible without authentication. orchestration-server, agent-management, and runtime-hardening have AuthMiddleware with role-based access control.
findings.impact: Any network caller can execute quality gates, approve/reject release candidates, access evidence store, and manipulate the quality gate pipeline without credentials.
findings.remediation: Install AuthMiddleware in quality_gates/api.py and add role dependencies (require_read, require_write, require_admin) to all endpoints. Configure ADMIN_API_KEYS, WRITE_API_KEYS, READ_API_KEYS environment variables.

findings.evidence: No service has TLS configuration. All Settings classes (orchestration_server/config.py, agent_management/config.py, runtime/config.py, quality_gates/config.py) lack cert_file, key_file, ca_file fields. All main.py entrypoints run uvicorn on plain HTTP (ports 8000, 8001, 8005). No HSTS middleware.
findings.impact: All API traffic transmitted in cleartext including provider API keys (auth_config), agent outputs, workspace data, and authentication tokens. Vulnerable to MITM attacks, credential theft, and data exfiltration.
findings.remediation: Add TLS configuration to all Settings classes. Configure uvicorn with ssl_certfile/ssl_keyfile in production entrypoints. Add HSTS header via shared middleware when TLS is enabled. Use environment variables for cert/key paths.

findings.evidence: crypto.py implements envelope encryption (AES-256-GCM) but ProviderService does not use it. create_provider() line 140 stores auth_config as plaintext. update_provider() line 184 updates plaintext. build_adapter() line 213 reads plaintext without decryption. 3/15 encryption integration tests FAIL: test_create_provider_encrypts_auth_config, test_get_provider_returns_encrypted_not_plaintext, test_update_provider_re_encrypts_auth_config.
findings.impact: Database compromise exposes all LLM provider credentials (OpenRouter, Anthropic, HuggingFace API keys). Insider threat or backup leakage exposes secrets. auth_config never encrypted at rest despite encryption infrastructure existing.
findings.remediation: Update ProviderService in services.py: 1) Call encrypt_auth_config() in create_provider() and update_provider() before persisting. 2) Call decrypt_auth_config() in build_adapter() when building adapter config. 3) Ensure ProviderResponse schema continues to exclude auth_config (already correct).

residual_risk.reason: shared/auth_middleware.py defaults AUTH_ENABLED=true but can be disabled via env. When disabled, all requests get full admin context. Must be documented as production risk.
residual_risk.recommended_action: Document that AUTH_ENABLED must be 'true' in production. Consider removing dev bypass or making it require explicit opt-in.

residual_risk.description: No CORS configuration on any service
residual_risk.reason: No CORSMiddleware added to any FastAPI app. Default FastAPI behavior undefined for browser-originated requests. Required before frontend integration.
residual_risk.recommended_action: Explicitly configure CORSMiddleware with allow_origins (explicit frontend origins), allow_credentials=false, explicit allow_methods/allow_headers.

residual_risk.description: No rate limiting on public APIs
residual_risk.reason: No rate limiting middleware (slowapi or custom) on any endpoint. Provider-level rate_limits only apply to outbound LLM calls, not inbound API protection.
residual_risk.recommended_action: Add rate limiting middleware per service: stricter limits on mutating endpoints, per-client (IP/API key) quotas, burst allowance with sustained rate caps.

residual_risk.description: Frontend test failures (ResizeObserver not defined in jsdom)
residual_risk.reason: 3 vitest tests fail due to @xyflow/react requiring ResizeObserver which jsdom lacks. Not a security issue but blocks CI green.
residual_risk.recommended_action: Add ResizeObserver polyfill to test setup (vitest.setup.ts) or upgrade jsdom version.

residual_risk.description: Dependency scanner uses demo advisory list only
residual_risk.reason: quality-gates/quality_gates/gates/security.py DEFAULT_ADVISORIES contains only 2 dummy entries. No real vulnerability detection without external feed integration.
residual_risk.recommended_action: Integrate pip-audit, safety, or OSV API via context['advisories'] injection in CI pipeline before production.
